properties.name: Gran Meliá Arusha
properties.description: Five-star Arusha hotel on Simeon Road with Mount Meru views, spa, infinity pool and a comfortable start or end to a northern-circuit safari.

properties.name: Four Points by Sheraton Arusha, The Arusha Hotel
properties.description: Historic city-centre hotel on Fire Road, convenient for Arusha arrivals and overnight stays before game-drive days.

properties.name: Kibo Palace Hotel
properties.description: Named after Kilimanjaro’s Kibo peak. A modern Arusha hotel about 45 minutes from JRO and a short walk from the business district.

properties.name: Mount Meru Hotel
properties.description: Large garden hotel facing Mount Meru, with pool, restaurants and easy access to JRO, Arusha Airport and the city centre.

properties.name: Legendary Lodge
properties.description: Boutique cottages on a working coffee estate in Arusha — a quiet first or last night before the northern safari circuit.

properties.name: Tarangire Sopa Lodge
properties.description: Circular suites among baobabs inside Tarangire National Park, known for elephant country and unfenced wildlife around the lodge.

properties.name: Tarangire Safari Lodge

properties.name: Farm of Dreams Lodge
properties.description: Garden lodge in Karatu on the Ngorongoro slopes, a practical overnight between Tarangire, Lake Manyara and crater days.

properties.name: Bougainvillea Safari Lodge
properties.description: Small Karatu lodge with garden rooms and homestyle meals — a comfortable pause off the dusty park roads.

properties.name: Marera Valley Lodge
properties.description: Karatu lodge near Rhotia with valley views, cottages in tropical gardens and easy access to Manyara and Ngorongoro.

properties.name: Maramboi Tented Lodge
properties.description: Raised tented suites on the Lake Manyara floodplain with Rift Valley views, between Tarangire and the northern circuit.

properties.name: Lake Burunge Tented Lodge
properties.description: Tented lodge near Lake Burunge, used as a Tarangire / Manyara overnight with easy park access.

properties.name: Mawe Mawe Lodge
properties.description: Boutique villas on the Rift Valley escarpment with views toward Lake Manyara National Park.

properties.name: Meliá Serengeti Lodge
properties.description: Meliá Collection lodge in the Nyamuma Hills of Serengeti National Park — a full-service base for central-plains game drives.

properties.name: Four Seasons Safari Lodge Serengeti
properties.description: Elevated lodge beside an active watering hole in central Serengeti, with infinity pool, spa and Big Five game-drive access.

properties.name: Serengeti Serena Safari Lodge
properties.description: Thatched rondavels on an acacia ridge overlooking the Serengeti plains — a classic central-park overnight.

properties.name: Ngorongoro Serena Safari Lodge
properties.description: Rim lodge on the Ngorongoro crater, positioned for early descent onto the crater floor.

properties.name: Ngorongoro Coffee Lodge

properties.name: Arusha Planet Lodge

properties.name: Tarangire Kuro Treetops Lodge

properties.name: Ngorongoro Oldeani Mountain Lodge

properties.description: Contemporary lodge in south-central Serengeti with plains views, pool and a full-service base for Seronera game drives.

properties.name: Nyikani Migration Camp — Kogatende
properties.description: Seasonal tented camp near the Mara River in northern Serengeti, positioned for wildebeest river-crossing season.

properties.name: Serengeti Ark Safari Lodge
properties.description: Northern Serengeti lodge in Kogatende, about 30 minutes from the Mara River crossing points.

properties.name: Ngorongoro Lodge Meliá Collection
properties.description: Meliá Collection lodge in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area, a full-service crater overnight with spa and dining.

properties.name: Ang'ata Ngorongoro Camp
properties.description: Tented camp in the Ngorongoro Conservation Area from Ang'ata Camps, used as a crater-area overnight.
